# Analysis to Audience

This part asks how a finished analysis reaches its readers honestly
and in a form they can check. It belongs to the second quarter. The
two case studies apply the earlier parts end to end; the last three
chapters concern what happens once the analysis leaves your hands.

- @sec-penguins works a complete analysis on the Palmer penguins
  data and maps each step to the chapter that taught it.
- @sec-adni works a harder case, prediction of conversion from mild
  cognitive impairment, with data held under a data-use agreement.
- @sec-ethics argues that the apparatus of this book does not, by
  itself, keep an analysis from misleading, and names what does.
- @sec-communicating writes the answer-first memo and the response
  to reviewers.
- @sec-federal covers federal public-access requirements and the
  deposit of each artifact in a repository.

If the quiz at the start of a chapter is easy, skip to the next.
The case studies are the least skippable chapters in the book,
because they are where the earlier tools are used together.
